findings.issue: `isBoundedAtImInfty_of_finiteRelIndex` is the bundled special case (`f : ModularForm 𝒢 k`, via `f.bdd_at_cusps'`) of the strictly more general fact the same PR proves inline at Trace.lean:322-326 for any `[ModularFormClass F 𝒢 k]` (via `ModularFormClass.bdd_at_cusps f`) — same three-step proof, two levels, neither named at the general level. summary: The new equality lemma itself is at the right level (ModularFormClass, no spurious DiscreteTopology). But the PR proves "a modular form for a finite-relative-index subgroup is bounded at i∞" twice: generally but anonymously inside qExpansion_one_norm_order_eq, and again as a bundled-type private helper in SturmBound.lean.
